reviews.author: Bailey R…
reviews.body:
The spa is a beautiful place, a warm welcoming environment with beautiful women entrepreneurs offering not only lash services but facials, laser hair removal, brow wax tint & laminations. I’ve Bridget getting my lashes don’t for over half a decade & honestly she never disappoints. She gives you what you want whether you describe it to her or bring a picture of a particular look. If you don’t know what you want then she gives you would would be most compliment to your eye and face shape. 

100/100 recommend.
